alerts.header: Line 1 Yonge-University: There will be limited nightly service starting 11 p.m., between Pioneer Village and Sheppard West stations on Monday, November 16 to Wednesday, November 18, for tunnel improvements.

Line 1 Yonge-University: There will be no subway service between York Mills and Eglinton stations, starting 11 p.m., nightly Monday, November 16 to Wednesday, November 18, due to structural maintenance. Shuttle buses will operate.
Line 2 Bloor-Danforth: Delays westbound from Kennedy to Donlands stations while we fix a signal problem at Warden station. Thank you for your patience.
Line 1 Yonge-University: No service between St George and St Andrew stations due to a mechanical issue at Museum station. Thank you for your patience.
